item.title: Avinatan Or’s mother reveals captor’s final words: 'Hamas is weak'
item.description: Ditza Or says a Hamas captor told her son the group was too weak to hold the remaining hostages, arguing that military pressure forced their release.

item.title: Mystery on the Lebanese border
item.description: IDF radar systems detected an unidentified object in the skies near the Israel-Lebanon border last night. IDF forces are conducting ground and aerial searches in an attempt to determine what it was.

item.title: Arutz Sheva poll: One-third of secular Israelis see plane rescue as ‘divine providence’
item.description: Nearly all Haredi and religious respondents attribute the rescue of passengers on the flight from Dubai to “Divine Providence," as do most traditional Jews.

item.title: The obligation of Torah study for men
item.description: Knowing the Torah’s guidance for living obligates men and women equally. Encompassing the entire Torah, commandments that are relevant to the learner’s life and those that are not, and continued study of the Torah in depth, obligates only men.

item.title: Trump on the Houthi attack on Riyadh: It's terrible
item.description:
In a conversation with reporters, US President Donald Trump referred to the Houthi attack on Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, and condemned it, saying: "I think it's terrible."
When asked whether the United States military would intervene following the attack, Trump replied curtly: "You'll find out."

item.title: 12 killed, 309 wounded in missile attack on Riyadh airport
item.description: At least 12 people killed and 309 wounded in a missile attack on Riyadh's airport, believed to have been carried out by the Houthis.

item.title: Report: US pressured Israel to strike Iran before elections
item.description: Trump administration urged Israel to launch a strike against Iran amid concerns over Tehran's military buildup, asking Israel to bear political risks ahead of elections, journalist Ben Caspit reports.

item.title: 37 Years Later: Bereaved family demands removal of monument to terrorist
item.description: Yaakov Farag was murdered while guarding Har Bracha in 1988. Now, his widow is demanding that the IDF demolish a nearby monument commemorating his killer.

item.title: A grotesque choice for the Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: The Jews are well and soundly surrounded by genocidal hatred, based on false Blood Libels, and Navi Pillay has helped to spread them. Opinion.

item.title: IDF: No unusual findings on Lebanon border
item.description:
IDF: Following the sirens sounded at 19:57 in Arab al-Aramshe, IDF surveillance identified an unknown aerial subject on the border with Lebanon.
IDF soldiers are continuing to search the area, and until now, no suspicious findings were located. There are currently no special instructions for the home front.

item.title: Sderot Yeshiva: Three years, two Simchat Torah celebrations
item.description: Moving video contrasts Simchat Torah at Sderot Yeshiva just hours after the October 7 massacre, with students singing under armed guard, and this year's celebrations filled with dancing and joy. Watch.

item.title: Man seriously wounded after accident gunfire
item.description: Man, 28, seriously wounded in Yavne after gun allegedly discharged from legally owned firearm; police investigate.

item.title: To those who carry our grief and refuse to surrender our joy
item.description: Hatred has consequences, but sometimes, the young Jew they hoped to intimidate becomes the young Jew organising the next Shabbat dinner. Sometimes, the identity they hoped to weaken becomes the source of a person’s strength. Sometimes, our children lift a Torah above their heads and dance. Op-ed.

item.title: Hostage's mother accuses IDF commander of failing to save her son
item.description: Iris Haim, whose son Yotam was mistakenly killed by IDF fire in Gaza, accuses former hostage commander Nitzan Alon of ignoring warnings, distress calls and signs that could have led to his rescue.
